Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614459 that have an exact measurement (standard_relation '=' and standard_value not null). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno, and filter by assay_id. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
